flows:
Navigate to https://www.meteoblue.com/en/weather/maps/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
Wait for the consent dialog.
From its initial focus press Tab four times until Manage options has focus, then press Enter.
In Manage your data, press Shift+Tab twice from the initial focus until Confirm choices is focused, then press Enter.
When the dialog closes, press Tab eight times from the initial page focus.
The last few stops are Help, an unlabeled control, the height choices, and Weather Radar.
Press Enter only when Weather Radar has focus.
Verify Weather Radar is selected and the map changed to the radar layer.
